decisions.reason: As a low-risk line extension in the firm's design-led core range that remained visible on its own page through 2024, it likely meets or is close enough to aspiration levels to justify retention.

Because it is a core drainage innovation aligned with seamless and barrier-free bathroom trends and stayed prominently marketed across 2023 and 2024, management would likely see performance as satisfactory and continue it.

Although the pump-drain niche looks more uncertain given the earlier withdrawal of a related 2023 pump-assisted product, its very recent 2024 launch and strategic fit mean the firm would probably give it more time before reallocating resources.
